note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are the author's own prose and allusions, bare citations, quotations recast to another person in the chapters' prayers, and two of Simpson's own titles — the hymn «እርሱ ራሱ» and «የሰማይ ቀናት በምድር ላይ», whose AV phrase OWB's Deuteronomy 11:21 does not carry.
